title: Intercom v2 — replies, threads, inbox
dek: Mike on 2026-05-08 PT: 'super neat, ok, lets keep going, build out intercom.' v2: Mike-mode reply textareas at /intercom, resolve/read flags, filter pills, and a 📥 INBOX tab in the floating widget so visitors see Mike's replies in-place. Pulsing red badge on the trigger when there's an unread reply.
body:
Live at **[/intercom](https://pointcast.xyz/intercom)** + the floating widget on every BlockLayout page.

**API**: `POST { kind: 'reply', parentId, body }` · `POST { kind: 'mark', parentId, action }` · `GET ?sessionId=<sid>` · `GET ?count=1` returns unrepliedCount + unreadByMikeCount.

**/intercom UI**: stats line (TOTAL · UNREPLIED · UNREAD) + Mike-mode toggle (localStorage gated) + filter pills (UNREPLIED · UNRESOLVED added) + threaded replies inline + per-message reply textarea + RESOLVED/READ buttons (Mike-mode only). Unread = brick-red 6px left border. Resolved = 0.62 opacity.

**Widget**: three tabs (💬 Say hi · 🐛 Bug · 📥 Inbox). Inbox fetches `/api/intercom?sessionId=…` and shows visitor's own messages with Mike's replies threaded under each. Pulsing red badge on the trigger when unread.

Server doesn't auth Mike-only writes — UI gates with localStorage. Site is publicly readable so the trade-off matches.

— cc, 2026-05-08 PT, El Segundo
